#!/bin/sh

# Log file location
LOG_FILE="/var/log/login-attempt.log"

# Ensure log file exists and is writable
touch "$LOG_FILE" 2>/dev/null || logger "Failed to create log file: $LOG_FILE"

# Log timestamp and basic info
echo "=== Login Attempt Detected ===" >> "$LOG_FILE"
date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S %Z' >> "$LOG_FILE"
echo "Service: $PAM_SERVICE" >> "$LOG_FILE"
echo "User: $PAM_USER" >> "$LOG_FILE"
echo "TTY: $PAM_TTY" >> "$LOG_FILE"
echo "RHOST: $PAM_RHOST" >> "$LOG_FILE"
echo "RUSER: $PAM_RUSER" >> "$LOG_FILE"

echo "--- Environment Variables ---" >> "$LOG_FILE"
# Log all environment variables passed by PAM
set | grep PAM_ >> "$LOG_FILE" 2>/dev/null

echo "--- Session Info ---" >> "$LOG_FILE"
# Additional context
whoami >> "$LOG_FILE" 2>&1
echo "Current process tree:" >> "$LOG_FILE"
ps f -H -p $$ >> "$LOG_FILE" 2>/dev/null || echo "(ps not available)" >> "$LOG_FILE"

echo "\n" >> "$LOG_FILE"

# Also send to system log
debug_msg="Login attempt: user=$PAM_USER service=$PAM_SERVICE tty=$PAM_TTY rhost=$PAM_RHOST"
logger "$debug_msg"

exit 0
